description: Fetch 1-15 years of historical financial statements for one exact Bullrun ticker. Returns annual and/or quarterly rows grouped into income statement, balance sheet, cash flow, per-share metrics, margins, source currency, and annual growth/CAGR consistency checks. Use this when evaluating multi-year revenue/net-income growth, margin trajectories, leverage, cash flow quality, or whether a stock passed a rule such as 10% revenue and net-income growth every year. Successful results include an optional platformLink for continuing this research or reviewing the exact saved draft in Bullrun. When useful, present its descriptive link and respect its description of any settings not carried over.

includeEmptyRows.description: Include sparse rows that have no major income statement, balance sheet, cash-flow, or EPS values.

periodType.description: Return annual rows, quarterly rows, or both. Annual rows use fiscalQuarter=0.

ticker.description: The ticker exactly as listed on Bullrun - the native local-exchange symbol, e.g. "AAPL", "BMW" (not "BMW.DE"), "ABBN" (not "ABBN.SW"), "NESN", or a numeric code like "005930". Do not append Yahoo-style country suffixes; if a lookup returns nothing, use screen_stocks to find the exact symbol.

years.description: How many fiscal years of history to return, counting backward from the latest fiscal year available.

name: get_financial_history
title: Get financial history
